settings.text: Dr. Mark Pinsky, a board-certified global leader in plastic surgery, created the world’s first patented delivery system that's becoming the talk of the town among women over 30. Why? Because it's changing the anti-aging industry (and saggy skin for good). This revolutionary technology allows cross-linked hyaluronic acid to deeply penetrate skin layers, offering plumpness and radiance without painful injections. Women everywhere are calling it their new beauty secret — The DermaTriPlex™.
